The '''1989–90 Primeira Divisão''' was the [[Primeira Liga#All-time Primeira Liga table|56th edition]] of top flight of Portuguese football. It started on 20 August 1989 with a match between [[G.D. Chaves|Chaves]] and [[F.C. Penafiel|Penafiel]], and ended on 20 May 1990. The league was contested by 18 clubs with [[S.L. Benfica|Benfica]] as the defending champions.

[[FC Porto|Porto]] qualified for the [[1990–91 European Cup]] first round, Estrela da Amadora qualified for the [[1990–91 European Cup Winners' Cup]] first round, and Benfica, [[Sporting Clube de Portugal|Sporting CP]] and [[Vitória S.C.|Vitória de Guimarães]] qualified for the [[1990–91 UEFA Cup]] first round. [[Portimonense S.C.|Portimonense]] and [[C.D. Feirense|Feirense]] were relegated to the [[Liga de Honra]]. [[Mats Magnusson|Magnusson]] was the top scorer with 33 goals.

==Promotion and relegation==

===Teams relegated to [[Liga de Honra]]===
*[[S.C. Espinho|Espinho]]
*[[A.D. Fafe|Fafe]]
*[[S.C. Farense|Farense]]
*[[Leixões S.C.|Leixões]]
*[[C.A.F. Viseu|Académico de Viseu]]

Espinho, Fafe, Farense, Leixões and Académico de Viseu were consigned to the Liga de Honra following their final classification in [[1988–89 Primeira Divisão|1988–89 season]].

===Teams promoted from Liga de Honra===
*[[C.F. União|União da Madeira]]
*[[C.D. Feirense|Feirense]]
*[[F.C. Tirsense|Tirsense]]

The other five teams were replaced by União da Madeira, Feirense and Tirsense from the Liga de Honra, as the league dropped from 20 to 18 teams.
